echoParts: in the heavens and on the earth
verseText: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
meaning: God has the power to do whatever he feels like, wherever he wants: all the way from heaven above down to the bottom of the sea.

recall.question: What does it mean that “the LORD does all that pleases Him”?
choices: He can do whatever He wants to do
He does whatever we want Him to do
He can do almost anything He wants

meaning.question: God does all that He pleases in heaven, on earth, and even at the bottom of the sea. What does that teach us about His power?
choices: There is no place beyond His rule
His power only works in heaven
He is afraid of the water

application.prompt: From the highest heavens to the deepest ocean, no place is beyond God’s rule. Think of a place where you feel nervous or unsure. How could remembering that God rules there too help you fight your fears?
